Controls.RequiredEvidence: Exact approved plan URLs; deny altered host/path/query/instrument/date and non-HTTPS.
Accepted host resolution, public-address checks and TLS validation in the isolated environment.
Redirect denied and proxy disabled; accepted transport configuration and isolated negative checks.
Exact 30 unique requests / 90 total attempts including retries, plus existing 20-attempt/hour ceiling.
One active worker; concurrent execution denied using the same accepted storage root.
Persist attempt reservation before request; verify consumed budget survives restart.
Cancelled execution stops admission/request/write; reservation remains accounted.
Bounded request timeout observed with controlled transport; timeout consumes attempt.
At most three attempts per unique request; every retry revalidates rights/consent/quota.
Failure threshold opens circuit; no further network calls while open.
Exclusive lease cannot be acquired concurrently across processes.
Interrupted reservation retained; completed request not downloaded again after restart.
Existing archive/version cannot be overwritten; changed execution receipt rejected.
Raw bytes, manifest and execution evidence digests verified; tampering rejected.
Archived input replay reproducible without network and with identical lineage.
Secrets, local roots and raw bodies excluded from public metadata/log evidence.
64 KiB response / 16 MiB total candidate store budget enforced before admission, including metadata.
